create.name: Ryumon Ji Zen Monastery
create.bio:
Ryumon Ji, the Dragon Gate temple, is a Sōtō Zen monastery at Weiterswiller in northern Alsace, about fifty kilometres north of Strasbourg, on the edge of a large forest. Master Olivier Reigen Wang-Genh founded it in 1999 with practitioners from Alsace and south-west Germany. He began Zen in 1973 as a student of Taisen Deshimaru, who ordained him in 1977, later led the Strasbourg dojo, was given transmission by Dōshō Saikawa Rōshi in 2001, and remains the abbot. A resident community of monks and nuns lives there by the traditional Sōtō rule, and the temple is recognised by the Sōtō school in Japan. It works in French and German, translating teachings and helping English speakers where it can.

The temple is open all year. Visitors can join the daily round of zazen, silent meals and samu work on 'daily life' stays, or come for sesshin, intensive retreats of three to nine days led by the abbot with talks, questions and one-to-one interviews; there are also beginners' weekends, kesa sewing and family retreats. A larger dojo for 120 people opened in 2024. Its YouTube channel, running since 2012, carries daily livestreamed zazen from the temple and short answers by the abbot to practitioners' questions, in French with German.

courses.title: Rôhatsu sesshin - Silent retreat
courses.description: A week-long silent sesshin in early December, the monastery's most intensive retreat of the year, with several periods of zazen a day, silent meals and work practice.

courses.title: New Year Sesshin & New Year’s Eve
courses.description: A four-day sesshin spanning the turn of the year at the monastery, combining zazen, ceremonies and community life.

courses.title: Teachings and transmission of the precepts of the bodhisattvas (Jukai)
courses.description: Several days of teaching on the bodhisattva precepts, ending in the jukai ceremony in which practitioners formally take refuge and receive them.

courses.title: MY FIRST ZEN RETREAT
courses.description: A weekend sesshin for people new to Zen, with an introduction to posture and the temple's forms alongside the regular schedule.

courses.title: Retreat & daily life - GYOJI
courses.description: Stays outside the sesshin calendar, following the monks' and nuns' day with morning and evening zazen, silent meals and samu. Booked by email for set periods.

free_resources.title: Zen online
free_resources.description: Daily zazen and teachings streamed live from the temple, which anyone can sit with at home.

free_resources.title: Videos: how to meditate with Master Wang-Genh
free_resources.description: Short instruction videos from the abbot on zazen posture and practice.
